thesis: The episode introduces Tina Lindstrom, a partner at First New York who manages an oil volatility portfolio and previously worked at Susquehanna managing equity index and commodity volatility groups. She explains that while equity index volatility typically exhibits a skew where fear is concentrated in downside moves, commodity volatility usually exhibits the opposite skew where fear is concentrated in upside moves due to supply shortages, though crude oil volatility can resemble equity-style volatility until a specific event causes it to flip back to the typical commodity pattern.
